title: GTA 6: The Festival Announced as a One-Off Live Music Event with PlayStation
description: Rockstar Games has announced GTA 6: The Festival, a special live music event in Miami presented with PlayStation to celebrate the game's launch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Launch Celebration: The Festival Announced in Miami

As the anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world action blockbuster continues to build, the marketing campaign is officially kicking into high gear. According to a recent report from gaming media outlet Push Square, Rockstar Games has announced **GTA 6: The Festival**, a special live music event designed to celebrate the launch of the game.

### A Partnership with PlayStation

Presented in partnership with PlayStation, this unique event brings together two heavyweights of the gaming industry to mark the release of GTA 6. PlayStation's involvement as a presenting partner underscores the massive scale of the game's launch rollout, offering fans an immersive prelude to the open-world experience.

### Key Event Details

Based on the official announcement, here are the essential facts regarding the event:

* **Event Name**: GTA 6: The Festival
* **Location**: Miami, Florida – the real-world inspiration behind the game's iconic setting.
* **Date**: November 21st, 2026
* **Event Type**: A one-off live music event

### Context and Analysis

Hosting the event in Miami is a fitting tribute to the roots of Vice City. While specific artist lineups, ticket distribution methods, or streaming details have not yet been detailed in the initial announcement, events of this magnitude typically serve as major cultural milestones for major game launches. Fans will undoubtedly be watching closely for any follow-up announcements regarding digital access or ticket sales as November 2026 approaches.

## Editor's Take

Hosting this exclusive celebration in Miami is a brilliant nod to the game's setting, and partnering with PlayStation elevates the event's prestige. While it's a one-off in-person gathering, we hope Rockstar will stream it globally so the entire community can join the hype.
